Corrected offline exporter now reproduces all 20 compared artifacts exactly across the original coarse-start and fine-start checkpoints, including both pull maps, validity, warped images, grid metadata, admission status and diagnostics. The failed first parity attempt is preserved: re-inverting the serialized fixed affine introduced maximum map differences 1.09e-12 mm (coarse) and 1.35e-12 mm (fine). Reconstructing the original (root.inverse, root) pair, with exact saved-coefficient validation, restores its cached inverse and exact output equality. Two focused affine/grid tests pass. Raw-only capture has reproduced all 30 scalar events and final optimizer diagnostics; its ordinary final export is still running, so full fit neutrality is not yet claimed.

The separate sampled-intensity derivative probe passes three tests each on JVM and Scala.js, and its acquired-image runner compiles. The fresh sealed intensity-chain pilot uses the same verified fine checkpoint, three directions, eight epsilon values and 0.005/decreasing-error criteria, plus exact comparison with all original derivative numbers. Numerical source 9c223081759c599574ba1c1bab82fe39f24dc0e112979325b0ed207900e0c475; no optimizer policy changed or qualification data used.
